title: Google Search Console MCP — SEO Analytics via Natural Language
description: Two independent MCP server implementations (AminForou/mcp-gsc and ahonn/mcp-server-gsc) connecting Google Search Console to Claude. Enables natural language queries against GSC data: traffic, rankings, content performance, click-through rates. The ahonn/mcp-server-gsc version syncs data to local SQLite for offline access and runs entirely locally (privacy-first). Both support Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Claude Code via npx install. Tutorial from March 22, 2026 confirms recent community activity.
redundancy_notes: No SEO/GSC tooling in registry. No analytics MCPs beyond DuckDB (OLAP). Workspace has ashitaorbis (3-tier blog, active) and the finance app (SaaS app) — both have public web presence that could benefit from SEO monitoring. Genuine capability gap.

evaluation.reasoning: Score of 63.25 in NEEDS_RESEARCH band. The capability is genuinely useful for ashitaorbis (active blog needing SEO monitoring) and the finance app, but several unknowns need resolution before APPROVED. Integration complexity is moderate (score: 75): npx install is easy, but one-time OAuth GSC setup adds friction. Token efficiency is neutral (score: 50) — this is a data access MCP, not an efficiency tool. Community validation scores 60 due to uncertainty in star counts across two competing implementations; the existence of two independent implementations suggests organic demand but also fragmentation. Key questions: (1) Which implementation is better maintained (star counts, last commit date)? (2) Is SEO monitoring currently a priority for ashitaorbis, or a nice-to-have? (3) Does the SQLite-backed offline version have acceptable freshness guarantees? If star count for either repo crosses 100 and ashitaorbis SEO is an active priority, this should be re-evaluated toward APPROVED.
evaluation.action: NEEDS_RESEARCH: (1) Check GitHub star counts and last commit dates for AminForou/mcp-gsc and ahonn/mcp-server-gsc. Prefer the more maintained one. (2) Assess whether SEO analytics is a current ashitaorbis priority (check blog CLAUDE.md). (3) Verify GSC OAuth flow works with claude code npx pattern. Re-evaluate when SEO becomes active priority.
